app_fee.value: The Graduate School's application fee is $38 USD, non-refundable.

fee_waiver.value: The application fee cannot be waived or deferred.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee cannot be waived or deferred and is non-refundable.

gre_general.value: The graduate school sets no GRE rule; it mentions GRE only as a score it accepts unofficially for contingent admission.

also.quote: USD accepts unofficial copies of English proficiency test scores, admission test scores (e.g., GRE, GMAT)

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 79 or higher is the minimum for international applicants.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall is the minimum for international applicants.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS Academic (International English Language Testing System) | 6.0 or higher

english_waiver.value: India is not on the list of countries whose degree holders are exempt from proof of English proficiency, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who hold a conferred degree from one of the following countries are exempt from providing proof of English proficiency: ... Zambia, and Zimbabwe.

notes: Graduate School page sets the $38 application fee (no waiver). The doctoral catalog entries (catalog.usd.edu, catoid=41) list $40 for BME, Biology, Biomedical and Translational Sciences, Chemistry, Data Science and Engineering, Physics and Sustainability; those program records carry the $40 figure. The Graduate School catalog page does not state a GRE General rule.
